title: Presentability of the infinity category of nonsymmetric infinity operads
statement: Fix universes and the infinity-category conventions of [def-coef-complete-algebroid], and let $\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}_{\mathrm{inert}}$ be the subcategory of $\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$ consisting of inert maps (those corresponding to inclusions of consecutive subintervals). Let $\operatorname{Opd}^{\mathrm{ns}}_\infty$ be the infinity category whose objects are small inner fibrations $\pi:\mathcal O^\otimes\to\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$ such that every inert map admits a $\pi$-cocartesian lift and the inert Segal maps $\mathcal O_{[n]}\to\mathcal O_{[1]}^n$ are equivalences, with the following relative-limit condition: for every $C\in\mathcal O_{[n]}$, its chosen cocartesian inert projections $C\to C_i$ over $\rho_i:[n]\to[1]$, every $X\in\mathcal O_{[m]}$ and every $\phi:[m]\to[n]$, composition gives an equivalence $\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal O}^{\phi}(X,C)\simeq\prod_{i=1}^n\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal O}^{\rho_i\phi}(X,C_i)$. Here $\operatorname{Map}^{\phi}$ is the homotopy fiber of the map on mapping spaces over the base arrow $\phi$; the empty product for $n=0$ is a point. An inert operad edge means a cocartesian edge over an inert base map. The morphisms of $\operatorname{Opd}^{\mathrm{ns}}_\infty$ are functors over $\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$ carrying inert cocartesian edges to inert cocartesian edges. Use presentability as in [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category]. In the fixed universe, $\operatorname{Opd}^{\mathrm{ns}}_\infty$ is a presentable infinity category: it is accessible and admits colimits of every small simplicial diagram.
